readings.moment: At dinner, when the temple struck nine and everyone was to put their watches on the cloth
When the temple struck ten, in the library
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door
A thump on the floor right above him, in the atelier
After the thump, when the uncle's repeater struck ten slow deep notes
When the temple struck eleven, as Girard and Félix stopped sitting together

durations: Girard sat with Félix in the library from his arrival at 10:32 (by Félix's watch) until the temple struck eleven
whereabouts: Félix was at the dinner table when the temple struck nine
Uncle (Aurèle) held the inspection at dinner and went round the table
Odile looked at her plate at dinner
Félix went up to the library after dinner
Félix drank brandy in the library, first one glass and then another
Félix stayed in the library alone
Someone went quickly up the stairs, past the library door, at 10:15 by Félix's watch; Félix did not see who
Someone came quickly down at 10:21 by Félix's watch; Félix did not see who
The thump sounded in the atelier, directly above the library
Félix was in the library directly under his uncle's bench
Félix's aunt was playing the piano downstairs when the thump came
Félix stayed where he was after the thump and finished his brandy
Girard came into the library at 10:32 by Félix's watch and sat with Félix until the temple struck eleven
